glossary.definition: (A) "Witness" includes a person whose testimony is desired in any proceeding or investigation by a grand jury or in a criminal action, prosecution, or proceeding.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2939.25 to 2939.29 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2939.25 - Attendance of witnesses at foreign grand jury proceedings definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "State" includes any territory of the United States and District of Columbia.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2939.25 to 2939.29 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2939.25 - Attendance of witnesses at foreign grand jury proceedings definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Summons" includes a subpoena, order, or other notice requiring the appearance of a witness.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 2939.25 to 2939.29 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 2939.25 - Attendance of witnesses at foreign grand jury proceedings definitions.
